items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: Herb Jeffries also recorded for them [Exclusive Records], and I recorded with the trio.

ctx.x: You were in New York, though. You mentioned something about being there in '44, didn't you.

Yeah, I was there in '44, but I was working out of New York more than... Well, my family lived in Brooklyn, I stayed with them, and I worked out of New York with the group I told you about -- the trio with Sir Charles and Luis Gonsales. Also we used to sing a lot of things. Because I used to write a lot of little songs. Like "Baby, I'm Gone" and stuff like that we used to sing. And we made records of those things.
